title: Systemic Analysis of Injection Site Pain from Subcutaneous Administration of FKB327
author: Takahiro Ito
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3r2gm8e

steps.title: Integrate VAS Data for Systemic Analysis
steps.instruction: Integrate Visual Analog Scale (VAS) data of injection site pain from studies FKB327-001, -002, -003, and -004 for randomized subjects with data collected immediately after injection at Day 1.

steps.title: Perform Subgroup Analyses
steps.instruction: Conduct subgroup analyses for VAS data and present the mean treatment difference and 95% CI via forest plots.

substeps.instruction: Analyze subgroups including study, device, subject type, age group, gender, weight group, race, ethnicity, and country.

steps.title: Calculate Treatment Difference via Linear Mixed Model
steps.instruction: Calculate the least squares mean treatment difference, 95% CI, and P-value using a linear mixed model.

substeps.instruction: Set fixed effects as subject type, age group, gender, race, ethnicity, weight group, device, and treatment.
Set random effects as country and subject.
Estimate other fixed effects using the same model.

steps.title: Perform Device Comparison Analysis
steps.instruction: Compare devices for VAS data collected after FKB327 injection in all subjects using a linear mixed model.

substeps.instruction: Set fixed effects as subject type, age group, gender, race, ethnicity, weight group, and device.
Set random effects as country and subject.
Calculate P-value using the same model.
Repeat the analysis specifically for subjects who experienced three types of FKB327 device.

steps.title: Perform Injection Location Comparison Analysis
steps.instruction: Compare injection locations for VAS data collected after FKB327 injection in all subjects using a linear mixed model.

substeps.instruction: Set fixed effects as subject type, age group, gender, race, ethnicity, weight group, device, and location of injection.
Set random effects as country and subject.
Calculate P-value using the same model.

steps.title: Summarize Injection Site Reaction Data
steps.instruction: Summarize all injection site reaction data by study visit for randomized subjects with data collected immediately after injection at Day 1.

substeps.instruction: Present the number and percentage of subjects for each category of reaction by treatment.
